answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the mirror of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Every claim climbs the kernel of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ember re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit.
